'''Iskaayuma''' was a [[city]] located on the [[planet]] [[Rodia]].<ref name="BMF 58" /> At the declaration of [[Grand Protector]] [[Navik]], it became the [[capital]] of Rodia during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Mustafar SWE" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Iskaayuma was introduced in the [[2016]] issue ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 58]]''.<ref name="BMF 58" /> The [[Iskaayuma/Legends|city]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[1996]] sourcebook ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="ShadowsEmpire">{{WEGCite|story=Street Drama|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
